---
name: ai-workspace-maintenance
description: "Use when adding, reviewing, or validating Gate-OS agent instructions, custom agents, prompts, skills, MCP configuration, or extension recommendations."
---

## Procedure
Check supported front matter and paths; keep descriptions discoverable; scope instructions narrowly; document tool permissions and external trust; validate JSON/YAML; ensure every agent has a charter and handoffs.

## Verification
Files are in supported locations, front matter parses, no secrets are present, links and commands are honest, and the workspace can be reviewed from a clean clone.
